subject: Coverage broker proposal and ops checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah (TalentComp) <sarah@talentcomp.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage broker proposal and ops checklist

Team —

We’re seeing a burst of onsite and final-loop interviews over the next three weeks for Platform Core (HIRE-3421). Rather than ad-hoc asks, I sketched a lightweight "coverage broker" approach to source float interviewers across squads while preserving skill match and debrief ownership. Draft attached (coverage-broker-proposal.pdf).

High level:
- A central broker (ops contact) maintains a short daily pool of available interviewers and a quick-swap calendar.
- Interview leads can request a slot via a simple form; broker offers 1–2 matched volunteers within 2 hours.
- Volunteers get short prep notes and an expected debrief handoff owner.

Asks:
1) Priyom — would your volunteer pool script be able to return matching volunteers by tag (e.g., infra, latency, systems design)?
2) Marissa — can Platform hires accept a 30m window where interviewer is briefed concurrently with candidate check-in?
3) Monica — ops checklist (ops-checklist.xlsx) has the handoff steps; can you review for any compliance gaps?

I’ve cc’d Sarah from TalentComp since they’ll be helping with candidate logistics; Alex Tan is on the candidate list for one of the final loops next week (included for transparency).

Goal: reduce last-minute declines and ensure someone owns the debrief so we don’t lose calibration. If you’re okay, I’ll pilot for one week starting Monday (4/26).

Thanks —
Jordan

Jordan Blake
Hiring Lead, Platform Core
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage broker proposal and ops checklist

Thanks Jordan — this looks promising. A few quick notes: 

- 30m prep-with-checkin is fine for most final loops, but we should reserve 45m for any interview that includes a systems design pair exercise (those usually need more context).
- Please add an "observation-only" tag in the proposal for managers who can shadow but not score; keeps the pool broader.
- For candidate experience: Sarah, can TalentComp help surface interviewer bios to candidates 24h in advance if the broker assigns someone outside the core panel?

On the compliance side, Monica — flag if we need to gate who sees candidate notes outside the hiring committee. We should also log interviewer swaps in the hiring ticket (HIRE-3421) so hiring managers can audit.

If Priyom can do the tag matching, I support piloting 4/26 for two weeks.

—Marissa

Marissa Cole
Manager, Technical Recruiting
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage broker proposal and ops checklist

Great timing — I can extend the volunteer matcher. Quick details:

- I already tag volunteers by skill, timezone, and seniority. I’ll add a "can-debrief" boolean so only people willing to own a short debrief are surfaced.
- I’ll expose a small API endpoint the broker can hit to get two best matches and a fallback pool. ETA: 48 hours.
- One operational caveat: volunteers get calendar nudges; for people with >2 conflicts in a week we’ll auto-opt them out for the second week to avoid burnout.

Jordan — for the pilot, I suggest we keep the broker hours 10:00–16:00 PT to cover most candidate times. That keeps volunteer churn manageable.

Priyom
Senior SRE, Interview Infrastructure
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage broker proposal and ops checklist

All set from ops side. Reviewed ops-checklist.xlsx and made three changes:
1) Added an explicit step to mark "debrief owner" in the hire ticket immediately after swap (audit trail).
2) Included a data-retention note: candidate notes must be flagged private and expire in 18 months unless moved to offer folder.
3) Added an emergency fallback: if no volunteers in 2 hours, escalate to on-call hiring manager rotation.

I attached the updated checklist. I’ll stand up the small Slack channel (#coverage-broker) for broker announcements and real-time swap confirmations. Jordan — if you want, I can run a 30m walkthrough with the ops/rec leads on Friday.

Monica Patel
Hiring Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ops-checklist.xlsx (updated), coverage-broker-proposal.pdf (annotated)
